device_id.description: Optional `$device_id` used to evaluate flags that bucket by device rather than by user. When omitted, the most recent `$device_id` on this distinct ID's events is used, so device-bucketed flags evaluate the same way they do for the SDK. Pass one explicitly to check a specific device.

flag_keys.description: Optional list of flag keys to scope the response to. When omitted, evaluation reasons are returned for every flag in the project, which can be a very large payload on projects with many flags. Pass the specific flag(s) you are debugging to keep the response small. Accepts either repeated query params (flag_keys=a&flag_keys=b) or a JSON array string (flag_keys=["a","b"]).

groups.description: Groups for feature flag evaluation (JSON object string)
